acceptanceCriteria: After a rebase onto the default branch, pre-push judges only the branch's own new commits
Without a readable origin/HEAD, or with a merge in range, pre-push falls back to @{push}..HEAD
diagnosis: runPrePush diffs @{push} against HEAD, so after a rebase and force-push the diff holds every commit already merged into the default branch. Root cause: the base ignores the default branch's remote ref (SPEC §4.3.2). Fix: base is the first parent of the oldest commit in HEAD --not @{push} origin/<default>, with fail-closed fallback to @{push}.
